result.finding: recorded: Published fish log BCF on log Kow slopes disagree on whether the slope lies in [0.7, 1.0]. Inside the band: Veith et al. 1979 (10.1139/f79-146) 0.85, n=55; Isnard & Lambert 1988 (10.1016/0045-6535(88)90040-9) 0.80, n=107 chemicals; Meylan et al. 1999 (10.1002/etc.5620180412) 0.77 for nonionic chemicals with log Kow 1-7, plus correction factors; Mackay 1982 (10.1021/es00099a008) BCF = 0.048 Kow, slope fixed at 1.0. Below the band: Arnot & Gobas 2006 (10.1139/a06-005) Table 4, acceptable-quality fish BCF, log BCF = -0.23 (SE 0.05) + 0.60 (SE 0.01) log Kow, n = 2393 BCF values, r2 = 0.52, regression over Kow > 1 with no upper bound; Neely et al. 1974 (10.1021/es60098a008) 0.542, n=8, and Davies et al. 1984 0.597, n=31, both as tabulated in Isnard & Lambert 1988 Table I. All values read from the PDFs on 2026-10-08. The Arnot & Gobas fit differs from H1's frozen analysis in range (log Kow > 0 with no cap at 6 vs 1 to 6), unit of analysis (individual BCF values vs one mean log BCF per chemical) and the absence of a neutral-chemical filter.
